info.title: TabPFN API
info.description: TabPFN REST API. For Python applications, use [tabpfn-client](/api-reference/overview). See the [REST quickstart](/api/rest-quickstart) for authentication and the upload, fit, and predict flow.

post.description: Request signed URLs for training features and targets. Specify each file’s `format` (`csv` or `parquet`); optionally supply a CRC32C `hash` for deduplication and `size_bytes`. Upload the bytes to each signed URL using its `required_headers`.

409.description: Training set already uploaded; reuse train_set_upload_id.

get.description: Returns the default model version, per-model limits, maximum limits, upload size limit, and asynchronous-processing settings. This compatibility route is deprecated on the server.

post.description: Fit an uploaded training set. Set `task_config.task` and `task_config.tabpfn_config`. For Thinking, include `thinking` in `tabpfn_systems` and set `thinking_config`. Long fits stream keepalive whitespace before the JSON response. Legacy flat `task`, `tabpfn_config`, and thinking fields are still translated by the server for older clients; new integrations should use the structured request below. `fit_mode` must be `fit_preprocessors` or `fit_with_cache`; cache mode cannot be combined with Thinking and is subject to server availability.
Request signed upload URLs for test features associated with a fitted training set. PUT the file bytes to the returned signed URLs using `required_headers`.

409.description: Test set already uploaded; reuse test_set_upload_id.

post.description: Predict using uploaded test features and a fitted training set. Select classification or regression in `task_config`; its `predict_params` controls the output. The response contains predictions, model metadata, and optional stage timings. Long-running requests may include keepalive whitespace before the final JSON payload.

Estimate an existing operation from raw input dimensions without consuming quota or reserving capacity. Thinking prediction requires the fitted model family and actual per-base-estimator count. Cache estimates assume a hit; fallback and the actual estimator count can change the final charge. Available when quota v3 is enabled.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token for authentication, obtained after signing up and generating an API key.

inference_config.description: Refer to tabpfn.inference_config.InferenceConfig for more details.
inference_config.title: Inference Config

hash.description: The crc32c hash of the file, used to deduplicate the file.
hash.title: Hash

size_bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes, used to compute the optimal number of chunks when chunking is enabled.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

use_chunks.description: Whether to split the the file into chunks and upload them in parallel.
use_chunks.title: Use Chunks

FitTimings.description:
Where a fit's time went. Queue wait covers everything outside worker
processing: waiting for a free worker and transport.

elapsed_s.description: Seconds from submission until the fit completed, or until now while it is pending.
elapsed_s.title: Elapsed S

queue_wait_s.description: Seconds the fit waited for a worker. Set once the fit completed.
queue_wait_s.title: Queue Wait S

train_set_transform_s.description: Seconds a worker spent loading, validating and preprocessing the train set. Set once the fit completed.
train_set_transform_s.title: Train Set Transform S

fit_s.description: Seconds a worker spent fitting the model; 0 when the model is fitted at predict time. Set once the fit completed.
fit_s.title: Fit S

FitTimings.title: FitTimings

train_set_max_cells.description: Maximum training cells per estimator: selected rows times uploaded columns. Row subsampling can keep each context below this limit even when the full upload exceeds it.
train_set_max_cells.title: Train Set Max Cells

train_set_max_upload_cells.description: Maximum cells in the full training upload before row subsampling. This bounds the table processed before estimator contexts are selected.
train_set_max_upload_cells.title: Train Set Max Upload Cells

test_set_max_rows_w_full_regression_outp.title: Test Set Max Rows W Full Regression Output

PredictTimings.description:
Where a predict's time went, per stage. Queue wait covers everything
outside worker processing: waiting for a free worker and transport. A refit
the server triggers counts towards the stage it happened in.

test_set_transform_queue_wait_s.description: Seconds the test set transform waited for a worker. Null when an earlier request already transformed this test set.
test_set_transform_queue_wait_s.title: Test Set Transform Queue Wait S

test_set_transform_s.description: Seconds a worker spent loading, validating and preprocessing the test set. Null when an earlier request already transformed this test set.
test_set_transform_s.title: Test Set Transform S

predict_queue_wait_s.description: Seconds the prediction waited for a worker.
predict_queue_wait_s.title: Predict Queue Wait S

PredictTimings.title: PredictTimings

force_reupload.description: Whether to force the upload of the file even if a file with the same hash already exists.
force_reupload.title: Force Reupload

force_reupload.title: Force Reupload
